items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Miles [Davis] got in there and saved a little something, because he and Gerry Mulligan put out progressive music.

ctx.x: The Chuck Berry thing was happening real early.

That’s right. So the masses of people that were behind bebop and whatnot – of course Miles [Davis] got in there and saved a little something, because he and Gerry Mulligan put out progressive music. So instead of calling it bebop . . .
Birth of the Cool and all that.
